description: Source file defining the PushRegistrationManager actor and related payload structures for push registration within an iOS app, including relay and direct transport handling.

classes.name: PushRelayGatewayIdentity

classes.name: PushRegistrationManager
classes.description: An actor managing push registration processes, including payload creation and relay registration.

methods.description: Creates relay registration payload, fetching and validating necessary data, and caching state.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if a relay handle expiration date has passed or is close to expiry.

methods.description: Computes SHA256 hash of a string and returns it as a hex string.

methods.description: Trims and lowercases token suffix strings, returning nil if empty.

methods.description: Encodes an Encodable payload to a JSON string.
